chunk_findings.detail: The driver tells agents that `ddflow task|phase|bug|research list` all “filter by state, phase, tag, owner and date”. The new help topic in the same change says a kind only accepts filters it has data for and that `bug list --tag x` is an error, not “everything”. An agent that follows the driver and runs `ddflow bug list --tag x` (or `phase list --owner …` / `research list --phase …`) does not get a filtered list; it gets a refused invocation. The docs copy of this bullet repeats the same claim.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/templates/drivers/implement-phase.md:369

chunk_findings.detail: The topic states that every viewer “prints one line per record”, then documents `ddflow show <id>` as “one whole record”. Given `ddflow show <task-id> --json` (or text), the payload is a full record, not one line, so a consumer that trusts the opening sentence and parses every viewer as line-oriented records mis-reads show (and any multi-line history/search body).
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/templates/prompts/help/viewers.md:5

chunk_findings.detail: “Exit codes: 0 rows, 2 nothing matched” reads as exit 0 meaning zero rows, which collides with exit 2 “nothing matched”. An agent that gets exit 0 from `ddflow task list --phase P2 --state open` and applies that sentence will treat a successful match as an empty result and skip work that is actually listed.
